toned milk Dairy Base Milk & Dairy Pasteurized cow/buffalo milk with fat content standardized to ~3%.
pasteurized toned milk Dairy Base Milk & Dairy Heat-treated milk to eliminate pathogens while preserving calcium and protein.
milk solids Dairy Derivative Milk & Dairy Dried milk components containing lactose, casein, and whey.
butter Dairy Fat Milk & Dairy Churned cream containing ~80% milk fat.
active lactic culture Fermentation Agent None Beneficial probiotic bacteria (Lactobacillus) used to culture curd and yogurt.
lactose Milk Sugar / Excipient Milk & Dairy Natural milk disaccharide; commonly used as tablet filler in pharmaceuticals.
lactose monohydrate Pharmaceutical Excipient Milk & Dairy Inert tablet binder derived from milk whey.
refined wheat flour Grain / Cereal Gluten & Wheat Milled wheat endosperm with bran removed (Maida).
whole wheat flour Whole Grain Gluten & Wheat Milled whole grain including bran, germ, and endosperm.
corn grits Grain / Cereal None Coarsely ground dried yellow corn.
rolled oats Whole Grain Gluten & Wheat Steamed and flattened oat groats rich in beta-glucan soluble fiber.
yeast Leavening Agent None Microorganism that ferments sugars producing carbon dioxide to rise bread dough.
peanuts Legume / Nut Peanuts High-protein edible seed; primary cause of severe peanut allergic reactions.
refined peanut oil Edible Oil Peanuts Extracted oil from peanuts; may retain trace proteins.
almonds Tree Nut Tree Nuts Nutrient-dense tree nut high in healthy monounsaturated fats.
cashew nuts Tree Nut Tree Nuts Kidney-shaped tree nut; potent allergen trigger.
sesame seeds Oilseed Sesame Seeds Calcium-rich oilseed and major allergen.
soy lecithin Emulsifier Soy Phospholipid derived from soybeans used to stabilize fat-water mixtures.
sugar Simple Sweetener None Refined sucrose for sweetness and preservation.
honey Natural Sweetener None Natural nectar collected by bees containing glucose and fructose.
citric acid Acidity Regulator None Natural organic acid (E330) used as a flavor enhancer and natural preservative.
potassium sorbate Preservative None Food and pharmaceutical antimicrobial preservative (E202).
sodium benzoate Preservative None Antimicrobial food preservative active against yeasts and bacteria.
paracetamol Analgesic & Antipyretic None Active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) for pain relief and fever reduction.
ibuprofen NSAID None Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug for pain, swelling, and fever.
amoxicillin trihydrate Penicillin Antibiotic Penicillin / Beta-Lactam Bactericidal antibiotic targeting bacterial cell wall synthesis.
potassium clavulanate Beta-Lactamase Inhibitor None Protects amoxicillin from bacterial enzymatic degradation.
diphenhydramine hydrochloride Antihistamine None First-generation H1 receptor antagonist for cough and allergy symptoms.
ciprofloxacin hydrochloride Fluoroquinolone Antibiotic None Broad-spectrum synthetic antimicrobial agent.
pantoprazole sodium sesquihydrate Proton Pump Inhibitor (PPI) None Gastric acid inhibitor for acid reflux, ulcers, and GERD.
fexofenadine hydrochloride Antihistamine (2nd Gen) None Non-drowsy peripheral H1 receptor antagonist for allergic rhinitis and urticaria.
salbutamol sulphate Bronchodilator (Beta-2 Agonist) None Rapid-acting inhalant bronchodilator for asthma and bronchospasm.
